section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 20, Nora kyrka/Tärnsjö-Östa
section.notes: Official Naturkartan page describes the written section as Nora kyrka/Tärnsjö to Östa or Ingbo källor. The GPX contains the main route plus several branch/spur segments toward Stenharsudd, Ljusbäck, Ingbo and Östa.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 20 GPX as primary geometry.
Preserve all six GPX segments separately. Do not join segment endpoints across the listed inter-segment gaps.
Treat Stenharsudd, Ljusbäck, Ingbo källor and Östa camping/beach as branches or endpoint-adjacent facilities depending on route selection.
Etapp 20 does not connect directly to Etapp 21; the next main numbered route begins at Siggeforasjön.
qa: Etapp 20 start coordinate is identical to Etapp 19 end at Nora kyrka.
Raw GPX total across all segments is longer than the official 10 km because it includes branches/spurs.
No within-segment step exceeds 500 m; all large jumps are between separate GPX segments.

importRows.name: Vatten, Nora kyrka
importRows.notes: Official route page states there is a tap at Nora kyrka April-October and water at the toilet year-round.

importRows.name: Toalett, Nora kyrka
importRows.notes: Official route page references toilet/water at Nora kyrka.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Stenharsudd
importRows.notes: Official route page and object page identify Stenharsudd as the mid-stage rest place with benches and fireplace at Nordmyrasjön. Object page says bring your own firewood.

importRows.name: Naturlig källa, Ingbo källor
importRows.notes: Official route page lists Ingbo källor as the natural water source. Naturkartan reserve page describes crystal-clear springs where water bubbles up from the bottom.

importRows.name: Ingbo källor
importRows.notes: Nature-reserve spring area and recommended highlight for Etapp 20/20:1.

importRows.name: Torrtoalett, Ingbo källor
importRows.notes: Naturkartan reserve page states accessible dry toilet at the parking area.

importRows.name: Tillgänglig stig och rastmiljö, Ingbo källor
importRows.notes: Ingbokällorna object page provides exact coordinate and confirms accessible trail/rest environment; keep as route-adjacent reserve rest POI.

importRows.name: Vatten, Östa camping
importRows.notes: Official route page states water is available in the Östa camping reception during opening hours. Seasonal/operator-hours dependent.

importRows.name: Kiosk/butik, Östa camping
importRows.notes: Official route page says Östa has camping with kiosk; object page mentions a small shop at the reception. Seasonal opening likely.

importRows.name: Östa camping
importRows.notes: Managed commercial campground with tent and caravan pitches, canoe/bike rental and reception services.

importRows.name: Östa stränder
importRows.notes: Long sandy beach in Östa nature reserve, reached from parking north of the campground. Route-adjacent/short detour, not the main GPX endpoint.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Östa stränder
importRows.notes: Beach object page and photos/text identify shelter at Östa north beach.

importRows.name: Grillplats, Östa stränder
importRows.notes: Beach object page says there is a grill/fireplace on the beach.

importRows.name: Rastbord, Östa stränder
importRows.notes: Beach object page says the beach has rest tables.

importRows.name: Toalett nära Östa stränder
importRows.notes: Östa stränder object and route context confirm public beach/rest context, but toilet placement is route-adjacent and should render as nearby rather than on-line.

importRows.name: Östa naturreservat
importRows.notes: Large nature reserve with long sandy beaches, old pines, trails and wetland/river environments. Use as area POI, not a single facility.

pending.name: Parkering, Ljusbäck
pending.reason: Confirmed parking on a GPX side branch. Keep pending until integration decides whether side-branch parking should render as a normal facility for Etapp 20.

pending.name: Parkering, Ingbo källor
pending.reason: Confirmed parking at Ingbo källor, but may be better modeled as access metadata or Etapp 20:1 endpoint access.

pending.name: Underhållsvarning, Etapp 20
pending.reason: Naturkartan translated page currently reports dense vegetation, fallen trees and difficult markings in a couple of places. Treat as current condition metadata, not a permanent facility.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Nora kyrka
suppressions.reason: Officially confirmed endpoint parking, but suppress as transport/access metadata unless the app imports trailhead parking as normal facilities.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats Tärnsjö centrum
suppressions.reason: Official access note: Tärnsjö centrum is about 500 m from Nora kyrka. Keep as transport metadata.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Gröna Kunskapshuset / Östa
suppressions.reason: Official endpoint parking exists at Östa/Gröna Kunskapshuset, but should remain access metadata unless trailhead parking is imported globally.

suppressions.name: Ingen buss till Östa
suppressions.reason: Official route page states there is no bus connection to Östa. Keep as access warning, not a rendered stop.

suppressions.name: Service i Tärnsjö
suppressions.reason: Route page lists hostel, grocery, cafe and fuel in Tärnsjö, but individual current businesses were not verified in this pass.

suppressions.name: Östa camping commercial services
suppressions.reason: Camping reception/kiosk and rentals are seasonal/operator services; import only stable camping/water/food rows with caveats.

suppressions.name: Östa naturreservat rules
suppressions.reason: Reserve rules and fire/camping restrictions need protected-area rule integration rather than one facility row.

suppressions.name: Etapp 20:1 Östa-Råsbo features
suppressions.reason: Masteråsen, Tärnmossen, Kungskällan and Råsbo belong to Etapp 20:1. Do not import them into main Etapp 20 except shared Ingbo/Östa endpoint context.

suppressions.name: Etapp 19 facilities
suppressions.reason: Österbo, Nordmyran and Skekarsbo belong to Etapp 19; only shared Nora kyrka endpoint utilities should appear here.

suppressions.name: Gap to Etapp 21
suppressions.reason: Main Etapp 21 starts at Siggeforasjön, not at Östa. Do not create an artificial handoff from Etapp 20 to Etapp 21.

checks: All normal rows have at least one source key present in sources.
Coordinates for Naturkartan objects with Google Maps links were extracted from those links.
GPX was downloaded from Naturkartan and parsed by segment; large inter-segment jumps are documented as branch topology.
Commercial/seasonal services are either caveated or suppressed as metadata.
Etapp 20:1 and Etapp 19 leakage are explicitly suppressed.
Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and import/pending boundaries rechecked.
Iteration 5 final pass: source references, decision buckets, counts, dedupe readiness and mapdata drawability revalidated.
limitations: Current maintenance warning was visible on translated Naturkartan page; recheck Swedish page/API before rendering as current alert.
Östa stränder is a short detour from the main endpoint and should be rendered as route-adjacent, not necessarily on-line.
Exact public availability/hours of Östa camping kiosk/reception water need current operator check before relying on them as critical services.
Current maintenance warning should be rechecked before rendering as a live alert.
Östa camping water/food are commercial/seasonal and remain medium-confidence service rows.
Östa stränder is a short detour from the main endpoint and should render as route-adjacent.

iterationLog.summary: Compiled first-pass Etapp 20 facilities from official Naturkartan route/object pages, Upplandsstiftelsen trip note, Heby/Nedre Dalälven secondary summaries and GPX segment QA. Focused on Nora kyrka utilities, Stenharsudd rest/fire, Ingbo springs/toilet/rest, Östa camping services and Östa beach detour facilities.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary claims are anchored in Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen. Secondary sources were used only for corroboration and route narrative. GPX branch structure was checked separately so side branches do not become false map connections.

Verify current Östa camping season/opening hours and whether drinking water is available outside reception.
Decide whether Ljusbäck and Ingbo parking should render as normal trailhead facilities or stay access metadata.
Recheck Naturkartan current-condition warning before final integration.
